title: Engineering diagnostic: testing the 4B, 12B, and multi-agent team pipelines end to end
summary: An 18-question engineering test of the 4B single model, 12B single model, and multi-agent team profiles to verify stage timing and formatting before running a full scored benchmark.
takeaway: Every setup ran end to end and recorded stage timings, while surfacing formatting and table-citation bugs that were fixed before the scored runs above.
